 Torch Technologies is seeking a TARCES Software Developer to join our team supporting the Tactical and Remote Command, Control, Communications, Computers, Cyber, and Intelligence (C5I) Edge Systems (TARCES) that are part of commercial and militarized vehicles, small and large crafts, transit cases, mobile communications, fixed base stations, command centers, and intelligence systems. **As a TARCES** 
**Software Developer your duties will include the following, but are not limited to:**
* Research, design, develop, and maintain computer and network software applications
* Analyze user requirements and develop software solutions to support operational and business needs
* Enhance and update existing software capabilities to improve performance and functionality
* Support integration of hardware and software systems and assist with technical specifications and requirements
* Maintain and support databases and coordinate development activities with cross\-functional teams
* Troubleshoot software issues and provide technical support as needed
